description:
Verify the Anthropic lane with a careful, cost-aware fixture and scenario pass.

Scope:
- add or refine curated Anthropic anchor slices
- record only the fixtures needed to prove the lane and its edge cases
- run scenario-backed verification against the chosen anchor models
- compare fixture behavior against current live responses to identify drift
- capture any metadata gaps versus implementation gaps discovered during the pass

Testing posture:
- replay first, targeted recording second
- avoid broad or redundant live calls
title: Verify Anthropic coverage with anchor slices and careful live fixtures
